FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 1, component changes in AUM by product type (in millions)
source.quote: Component changes in AUM by product type for the five years ended December 31, 2025 are presented below (1) . (in millions) ... December 31, 2025 ... Total $ 8,676,680 $ 2,474,531 $ (33,124 ) $ 238,411 $ 2,912,232 $ (227,212 ) $ 14,041,518

ecosystem.notes: AUM is a stock of client money, not a flow, so no take rate is computed on it. BlackRock's fee is the platform's share of client returns: the 10-K says "Investment management fees are typically earned as a percentage of AUM", and BlackRock also earns performance fees and technology services (Aladdin) revenue. The investment returns on the AUM belong to BlackRock's clients. The 10-K describes it as "$14.0 trillion of assets under management ("AUM") at December 31, 2025"; the increase from $11.6 trillion includes AUM acquired with HPS (July 2025) and ElmTree (September 2025).
